what_it_is: Pratt & Whitney Canada (P&WC), a unit of RTX, is the world's leading maker of regional and general-aviation turboprop and turbofan engines, including the ubiquitous PT6 family and PW100 series. Its engines power a large share of the world's light transport, trainer and utility aircraft.
india_angle: P&WC engines power key Indian aerospace programmes - the PT6 family has equipped Indian civil and defence-adjacent platforms, and RTX's India materials highlight a growing Indian fleet of Pratt & Whitney-powered aircraft. India's MRO ecosystem for P&WC engines is expanding as the regional fleet grows.
intelligence_assessment: P&WC's India presence is broad but diffuse - engine-by-engine India programme attribution requires type-certificate level research. The strategic signal to watch is any deeper Indian MRO or component work delegated to Indian industry.

faq.q: Is Pratt & Whitney Canada the same as Pratt & Whitney?
faq.a: P&WC is the Canadian subsidiary within RTX, focused on regional/general-aviation turboprops like the PT6; it is distinct from the US large-engine business.
